descripcion_geo: Greek city on the coast of Libya (North Africa), with a significant Jewish community in the NT period.
importancia_estrategica: Greek city in North Africa; cradle of Simon who carried the cross of Jesus.

historias.titulo: Simon of Cyrene carries the cross by Jesus
historias.descripcion: Simon of Cyrene, who was coming from the countryside, is forced to carry the cross of Jesus on the way to Calvary.
Among the Jews who have arrived at Jerusalem for Pentecost are men from Cyrene who hear the gospel.
Men from Cyprus and Cyrene are the first to preach the gospel to the Greeks in Antioch.

personajes.descripcion: Forced to carry the cross of Jesus; Mark mentions that he was the father of Alexander and Rufus.
Among the prophets and teachers of the church of Antioch was a Lucius of Cyrene.
Paul greets a Rufus in Rome, possibly the son of the Cyrenian who carried the cross.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: African city with active Jewish community; Simon of Cyrene is the best-known figure in the NT; Its citizens are among the first evangelizers.

cristianismo.descripcion: Simon of Cyrene, a Gentile from Africa, carried the cross of Jesus; figure of the disciple who 'takes up his cross' (Lk 9:23).
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Simon of Cyrene, a Gentile from Africa, carried the cross of Jesus; figure of the disciple who 'takes up his cross' (Lk 9:23).

historias.titulo: Simon of Cyrene and the cross
historias.descripcion: Simon, arriving from the countryside for Easter, is forced to carry Jesus's cross.
Jews from Cyrene were in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost and heard the gospel.
Men from Cyrene were the pioneers in preaching to the Greeks in Antioch.

personajes.descripcion: He carried the cross of Christ; symbol of discipleship.
Greeted by Paul in Rome as 'chosen in the Lord'.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Cyrene contributed to the gospel with Simon (bearer of the cross) and with pioneer evangelizers.

cristianismo.descripcion: Simon of Cyrene, from Africa, is the image of forced discipleship that becomes grace.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Simon of Cyrene, from Africa, is the image of forced discipleship that becomes grace.
